examples.text: Nous voilà enfin arrivés devant le grand hôtel.
examples.trans: Here we are at last in front of the grand hotel.

meanings.note: n'avoir rien à voir avec = to have nothing to do with
Voir quelqu'un. French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire'). Core French verb meaning 'to see'.

examples.text: Magali, je dois voir la pièce de Koltès cette semaine.
examples.trans: Magali, I have to see the Koltès play this week.

meanings.note: Manner adverb formed by adding '-ment' (from Latin 'mente', 'with a ... mind') to the feminine adjective stem.

examples.text: Tu crois vraiment qu'il va accepter ce rôle?
examples.trans: Do you really think he is going to accept this role?

examples.text: Je suis vraiment désolée pour ce petit retard.
examples.trans: I am truly sorry for this slight delay.

meanings.note: Il y a = there is / there are. High-frequency French pronoun meaning 'there'; clitic object forms precede the conjugated verb.
J'y pense = I think about it. High-frequency French pronoun meaning 'there'; clitic object forms precede the conjugated verb.

examples.text: S'il vous plaît. Il n'y a rien entre Mathias et moi, d'accord?
examples.trans: Please. There's nothing between Mathias and me, okay?
